mannequin.glb is derived from UAL1_Standard.glb of the Universal Animation Library [Standard]
by Quaternius (https://quaternius.itch.io/universal-animation-library,
https://quaternius.com/packs/universalanimationlibrary.html) and UAL2_Standard.glb of the
Universal Animation Library 2 [Standard] (https://quaternius.itch.io/universal-animation-library-2,
https://opengameart.org/content/universal-animation-library-2), both downloaded on 18 Oct 2026.
Both use the same skeleton.

Kept: the Mannequin mesh and skeleton and these clips:
- from UAL1: Idle_Loop, Walk_Loop, Jog_Fwd_Loop, Sprint_Loop, Jump_Start, Jump_Land, Roll, Yes,
  Idle_No_Loop;
- from UAL2: Slide_Start, Slide_Loop, Slide_Exit.
Everything else removed and the file quantised with gltf-transform 4.5.1.

Quaternius published the Quaternius Asset License v1.0 on 28 Aug 2026; its section 7 says it does
not apply retroactively (https://quaternius.com/license.html). Both zips, as downloaded on
18 Oct 2026, ship the License.txt below.

The License.txt shipped in each pack (UAL1 and UAL2, identical apart from a Discord link in
UAL2) reads:

-------------------------------------------------------
License:
CC0 1.0 Universal (CC0 1.0)
Public Domain Dedication
https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/

------------------------------------------------------
Models by @Quaternius
